findings.text: follow-on: "assert set(signal_role_questions()["signal_role"]["criteria"]) == set(ROLE_CRITERIA)" compares the function under test against the module's own constant, so it can only fail if that function hardcodes a set differing from ROLE_CRITERIA and cannot catch a wrong or missing role definition that appears in both; it is not independent of the code it checks.

follow-on: "assert accepted == [{"id": "sample", "signal_role": "measured", "cost_usd": 0.002}]" compares the result against the value fake_decision returned, so both sides move with the input the test supplied and the assertion survives a regression that hardcodes the accepted role or the cost rather than reading them through judge_rows.
